caller_has_validator_role.meaning: the caller of batchTransfers/rBatchTransfers holds the validator role

standard_flow_kyc_gate_enforced.meaning: standard transfer/transferFrom/mint/burn revert when the recipient (and for mint/burn the holder) is not isKycVerified, and standard transfer requires whenNotPaused
standard_flow_kyc_gate_enforced.checkpoint: standard transfer flow, before batch transfer call

token_paused_before_batch.meaning: the token is in the paused state (whenNotPaused would block standard transfer) at the time the batch transfer is invoked

batch_funds_moved_while_paused.meaning: batchTransfers/rBatchTransfers debit and credit _balances, i.e. fund movement occurs, while the token is paused

assumptions: The pause state is an observable contract state that standard transfer consults via whenNotPaused.
Fund movement means a debit/credit mutation of _balances (and _rBalances) by the batch helper.
The report describes the pause bypass as a capability of the batch paths rather than an observed paused transaction.

unresolved.description: Report does not establish whether the token was actually paused at the time of a batch transfer; pause bypass is stated as a capability, so the paused-before-batch state is a scenario assumption rather than an observed fact.
Report does not specify whether batchTransfers and rBatchTransfers are both required or either alone suffices for the pause bypass; the plan treats either batch path as the movement mechanism.

limitations: No concrete amounts, token quantities, or addresses are given for the moved funds; the effect is encoded as an observable occurrence of fund movement while paused.
The KYC-gate bypass impact (v_kyc_bypass_single_call) is not formalized by this plan; only the pause-bypass impact is in scope.
Whether the validator is malicious or merely privileged is not resolved; the plan only requires the validator role as a precondition.
